The '''School of Cairhien''' is an [[academy]] set up by [[Rand al'Thor]] after he took the city from the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. It's located in Lord [[Barthanes]]'s [[Lord Barthanes Manor|former manor house]] in [[Cairhien]]. Rand offered funding and rewards to inventors in the city who would contribute to the school, in an effort to recover some of the lost knowledge from the [[Age of Legends]].
